needs.label: Step-free entrance
needs.evidence_rule: A verified route from the street to the entrance; overall wheelchair tags alone are not converted.
needs.filter_rule: At least one specifically named entrance reported step-free by an operator. Full street routes are not inferred.

needs.label: Accessible toilet
needs.evidence_rule: Explicit toilets:wheelchair, or wheelchair on an amenity=toilets object; source claim, not independent verification.
Detailed public-floor access assessment required; lift existence alone is insufficient.
needs.filter_rule: Disabled when there are no positive all-public-floor assessments. Mapped lifts are offered as a separate query.

needs.label: Changing Places toilet
needs.evidence_rule: Verified facility listing or detailed facility audit required; adult changing table alone is insufficient.
needs.filter_rule: Disabled while official registered-facility evidence is unavailable. An external official map is linked.

floor_answer_one_policy: Preserve the raw answer. Ask whether the building has only one public floor or only one of several floors is accessible; do not auto-map to yes or partly.
coverage_metric: Recognised overall OSM wheelchair tags divided by selected OSM objects, not community answers or detailed-need coverage.

coverage_bands.purpose: Retained prototype display heuristic; not a statistical confidence interval.

score_metric: 100 * (yes + 0.5 * limited) / (yes + limited + no); designated excluded. Overall OSM wheelchair-tag proxy, not a step-free score.
known_source_records_scope: Original core OSM fields only; effective filter coverage is in need_evidence.json.
